findings.description: Thomas Richison (also recorded Richardson / Richeson) was the father of John Richardson. Born 18 February 1804 in Wigan, Lancashire, England; died 3 November 1886 in Richmond, Cache County, Utah. Father and son share a documented Nauvoo residence (1839–1846) and a joint 1852 emigration to Utah, which bridges John's English origin to his Utah life.
supporting_sources: Nauvoo Community Project (BYU Center for Family History and Genealogy) — the Richardson/Richison family in Nauvoo, Hancock County, Illinois, 1839–1846.
LDS Church membership and Utah Mormon Pioneer Overland Travel records placing Thomas and John Richardson in the same emigrating household.

findings.description: Mary Mallalieu (married name Richardson) was the mother of John Richardson. She married Thomas Richardson on 12 November 1826 at Walton-le-Dale, Lancashire, England, and died 9 March 1846 in Nauvoo, Hancock County, Illinois — before the family reached Utah, so she is absent from every later Utah record. Recover her via the Nauvoo community records (which name her, variant-spelled Millenew / Mallalew) and the 1826 Lancashire marriage. Her birth was 16 September 1802 (per the Find a Grave index; the year is debated in the tree). The tree's 16 September 1806 Chorley christening is a MISATTRIBUTED record for a different Mary Mallalieu who died in 1812, so a precise birth date is not required for this finding.

target_person.name: Mary Mallalieu
target_person.birth: 16 September 1802, Lancashire, England (per Find a Grave; year debated) — NOT the misattributed 16 Sep 1806 Chorley christening, which is a different Mary Mallalieu who died 1812
